# Project instructions

- Treat this repository as a documentation site for Browser-act and keep changes scoped to the relevant docs, navigation, or content area.
- Prefer the smallest valid documentation update that solves the current task; avoid unrelated cleanup, speculative rewrites, and broad restructuring.
- Keep content aligned with the product and repo structure: overview, quick-start, workflow, agent-cli, browser-proxy, bot, integrations, account-billing, support, and FAQ.
- When modifying docs, preserve the existing information architecture and naming conventions already used in the repository.
- Validate the affected content with the smallest relevant check. For local preview, use the Mintlify app from the repo root with: npx mintlify@latest dev.
- If a task is blocked by missing context, identify the minimum missing fact before asking the user for details.
- Report progress with the current status, the chosen next action, and any remaining risk or follow-up.
